specification.title: Institutional leadership portfolio and final integration
specification.outcome: Defend an integrated strategy and demonstrate the limits and strengths of one's preparation.

genre: Professional institutional leadership with complete original economic/financial models and inspectable decision artifacts; no fabricated real leadership.
requirements: Two complete original integrated academic-financial leadership portfolio cases connecting governance, research, teaching, capital and risk, with inspectable dossier artifacts and quantitative global reasoning. Include actual-work evidence requirements, external human evaluation protocol and honest continuing-development plan. Distinct from standalone leadership portfolio cross-assessment, which will separately require full real-work submissions; this chapter teaches integrated decision defense using substantive synthetic worked dossiers and eight full solutions. No invented learner achievement or final-world mastery certification.

Read necessary accepted economic/financial/research/teaching prerequisites and canonical coverage. Use bounded inspected primary sources for unresolved claims; original models and cases. Current laws/regulations or institutional policies require fresh official dated jurisdiction-aware retrieval; do not use broad professional advice as legal authority. Reuse stable verified source scopes with original inspector attribution. No fictional evidence represented as real responsibility.
